extraction_notes: Only SI Figure S6 contains catalytic-performance plots suitable for digitisation. SI Figure S6b TOF bars at 450 °C were combined into the corresponding 450 °C records from SI Figure S6a. Space velocity is not stated in the S6 caption; 24 L h-1 gcat-1 was taken from SI Table S4 entries for this work under matching Ru/BaCeO3-a performance conditions.
